verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ixik, b'at halan yab' heb' aj Jerusalén to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Tzin nawalkoti ayik ex wak'anoch in chonhab'ok. Ix in he k'anab'ajej wal, ix in he xajanej wal, icha junok ix kob'es toto snupnaji xajanan winh yetb'eyum. Ix ex ochwal tzak'an wuj t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a lum malaj b'aj tz'awchaj tas t'ay.
Ayik chi' wiknhej heyaj a ex israel ex tik, icha wal b'ab'el sat awb'en. Ha in Jehová in swala' to yalnhej mach heb' ex ixtani, ix och smul heb', ix wak'kot yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'ayin.
E masanil ex yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, haton winhaj Israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.

Syalan t'ayex icha tik: ¿Tas in palta'il ix yil heb' he mam eyicham? ¿Tas yuj ix in spatikejkanel heb', haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yal sb'a heb'? Yuj chi' manhxalaj jab'ok ix ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Majxo in snakot heb', wach'chom a in ix wik'elta heb' t'a Egipto, ix wik'an b'ey heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um, lum takinh sat, lum pak'kiltak, lum malaj mach kajan t'ay, lum malaj mach tzek' t'a sat.

Ha in ix wak'och heb' t'a lum te yax sat tik, b'aj te ay tas wach' syab'lej heb'. Palta a exxo yinhtilal ex heb' tik, ex kajan ex t'a sat in lu'um tik, ix eyixtejb'at lu'um yuj he chukal, yuj chi' maxtzak scha in k'ol jun in lu'um tik.

Ha heb' sacerdote maxtzak in snakot heb'. Ha heb' tzex k'ayb'ani, maxtzak in yojtakejel heb'. Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, haxo heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a sb'i Baal syalel heb'. Haxo t'a komon Dios syal sb'a heb', haton juntzanh malaj jab'ok tas wach' syik' heb' t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' owal heyet'ok yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal.

Ixikek t'a chonhab' Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, tzeyilan wal. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a chonhab' Cedar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'at yilan wal heb' tato ayxo b'aj tzuji icha wal jun tik.

¿Tom ay junok chonhab' skomon aktankan sdiosal, wach'chom a sdiosal heb' chi' manh Diosok? Ha exxo ex in chonhab' ex tik, ix in eyaktejkani. Wach'chom a in ix ex wak' wal b'inajok, palta haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, hata' tzeyal he b'a.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Ex kajan ex t'a satcha'anh, satokab' he k'o'ol, cheklajokab' xiwelal t'a he sat yuj tas wan yuji tik.

Ha in chonhab' tik, cha makan smul ix och t'ayin: Ha in tik lajan in icha sjaj ha ha' sk'euli, palta ix in spatikejeli. Ix sb'oanpax sdiosal lajan icha yet'tal ha ha' jateltakxo, maxtzak yal-laj skan wa'an ha' t'a yo'ol, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik, manh chekab'ok eyajkaneli, palta ¿tas yuj tzex ixtaj icha tz'utaj heb' chekab'?
¿Tas yuj ix och heb' anima ajk'olal t'ayex? Icha yel yaw nok' choj icha chi' yel yaw heb' t'ayex. Ix kan tzinan he lu'um, ix tz'ab'at he chonhab'. Manhxa mach syal skajnaj t'ay.
Ha heb' soldado aj Menfis yet' heb' aj Tafnes yik Egipto, ix smak'poj he jolom heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik ix eyik'kot t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix in he patikejel a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, yakb'an ix ex in kuchb'ej b'eyok.

Haxo tikne'ik ¿tas tzeyak' yala', yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Egipto ay t'a sti' ha' Nilo? ¿Tas pax tzeyak' yala' yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Asiria ay t'a sti' ha' Éufrates?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala': Ha wal he mul chi' ol ik'ankot eyahelal t'a eyib'anh. Ha he pitalil ol ak'anb'at t'a eyib'anh. Nachajokab'el eyu'uj to te chuk ix he k'ulej yujto ix in he patikejeli, a in Jehová he Diosal in. Ol wak'och yahelal t'a eyib'anh yujto malaj welk'och t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Atax t'a peka' ix ex och ijan he pitan he b'a t'ayin. Maj yal he k'ol ix in he k'anab'ajej. Ix eyalani: Malaj ko gana tzach kak' serwil, xe chi. Haxonhej ajmulal ix he k'ulej t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.
Icha wal tz'aj yawchaj te' uwa te wach', icha chi' ix aj ex wawani, lajan ex icha yinhatil te' uwa te wach'. ¿Tas yuj lajanxonhej tzex ajkan icha te' kaltakte'al uwa?

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Wach'chom tze komon b'ikejel he b'a yet' k'e'en yal ta'anh, mato niwan xapon tzeyak'ek' t'ayex, palta a he mul chi', chekel yajek' t'a in sat. Malaj b'ak'inh syal he sakb'ikani.

Tze komon halan icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko juel ko b'a kalan ko b'a t'a komon Dios, xe chi. Naekkoti, tas ix eyutej he b'a t'a lum ch'olkixtak. Tonhej tzex komon ek' jechechok icha junok nok' nun camello sayanek' nok' smam.

Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' kaltakte'al nun b'uru k'ajan sb'eyek' b'aj malaj anima, suk'lan nok' tzek' nok' ayik wan stajni nok'. Malaj mach syal syaman wanaj nok'. Ayik stajni nok' chi', sekojtak tz'aj schax nok' yuj nok' mam b'uru chi'.

Ex israel, aktejek he b'eyek' he sayanek' he komon diosal. Nab'anhej slajwi eyok yet' stakji he ti' he b'eyek'i. Palta a ex tik tzeyala': Ma'ay, ayoch ko pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ol kalnhej ko b'a t'ay, xe chi.
Icha wal sk'ixwi junok elk'um ayik syamchajelta, icha wal chi' ol aj he k'ixwi a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, heb' eyajal, heb' sacerdote yet' pax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok.

Tzeyal t'a junok te te' icha tik: Mamin, xe chi t'a te'. Tzeyalanpax t'a junok k'e'en k'e'en: Nunin, xe chi. Haxo pax t'ayin jun, a yich he patik tze meltzitejkoti. Maxtzak ex kot k'elan t'ayin. Haxo wal yik tzeyilani to ay tas tzex ik'ani: Kotanh, kolwajanh, xe chi t'ayin.

Ex aj Judá, icha wal sb'isul he chonhab', icha chi' sb'isul he diosal. ¿B'ajtil ay juntzanh he komon diosal ix he b'o chi'? Kotokab' heb', ol kilani tato ol yal ex skolan heb' ayik ol jawok yahelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tas in mul t'ayex yuj chi' tzeyalub'tanhej to max ex in kolo'? Ina he masanil tze pitej he b'a t'ayin.
Nab'anhej swak'och eyahelal, maxtzak yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al. Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' choj te ow, tze milcham heb' in chekab' swak'b'at t'a he kal.

¿Tas anima'il heyaj a ex yinhtilal ex kan Israel? Maklejek eyab' tas swala'. ¿Tom malaj jab'ok tas swak' t'ayex? ¿Tom icha takinh lu'um waj t'ayex, mato icha junok lum lum te ay smay? Ex in chonhab', ¿tas wal yuj tzeyal t'ayin icha tik: Munil kik ko b'a, malaj tzach och ku'uj? xe chi.
¿Tom ol sat sk'ol junok ix kob'es t'a stonh, ma t'a spichul ayik sb'at ix t'a nupnajel? Palta a exxo pax in chonhab' ex tik, junjun k'u tzin b'atnhej satk'olal eyu'uj.
Lajan ex icha heb' ix ajmul ix yojtak b'e b'aj sb'ati, ayik sayanek' heb' winh winak heb' ix. Sat k'ayb'um heyaj t'a chukal.
Te chik'tak he pichul yuj schik'il heb' meb'a' yet' heb' malaj smul. Tze milcham heb', wach'chom malaj b'aj tz'och heb' elk'al t'ayex.

Wach'chom tze k'ulej icha chi', palta tzeyalan icha tik: Ha onh tik, te wach' onh, malaj ko mul, manhxalaj yowal sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Palta a in Jehová in tik ol wak'kot yahelal t'a eyib'anh, yujto tzeyala' to malaj he mul.

¿Tas yuj tze pech he b'a yik tze k'exan heb' tze nib'ej skolwaj heyet'ok? Icha wal ajnak yel he k'ixwelal yuj heb' aj Asiria, yujto maj ex skol heb', icha pax chi' ol aj yel he k'ixwelal yuj heb' aj Egipto.
Toxonhej nhojan ex em yuj k'ixwelal ayik ol ex meltzajkot t'a Egipto chi', yujto toxo ix in patikejel heb' tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol chi'. Malaj tas ol eyak' yal yet' heb', xchi Jehová.
